v1.3.2 — added Step 0 auto-update to standard workflow (silent git pull --ff-only on first use per conversation, ignored if not a git checkout). See https://github.com/Agents365-ai/agent-native-design/releases/tag/v1.3.2

v1.3.1 — added references/testing.md (CI recipes for envelope contracts, idempotency replay, TTY behavior, schema drift, etc.) and bilingual concept hero. Earlier v1.3.0 split SKILL.md into core + references/. See https://github.com/Agents365-ai/agent-native-design/releases/tag/v1.3.1
